title.zh: 黄仁勋争抢AI入口：英伟达44%营收靠三家客户
title.en: 黄仁勋争抢AI入口：英伟达44%营收靠三家客户

current_state.zh: Nvidia is racing to buy or invest in AI developer entry points — agreeing to acquire Hugging Face for about $12.9B, losing OpenRouter to Stripe, and planning a roughly $3B investment plus agent partnership with Perplexity — as its revenue grows dangerously concentrated, with three direct customers accounting for 44% of sales.
